posts.headline: Sixteen editions of doubt and Thicks is STILL 3-0 at a league-low-among-unbeatens 403.68 points — a champion coasting on fumes, not pedigree.
posts.detail: Klint's Clipboard owns the ring but their 5.5 average finish says the suspicion is earned, not manufactured. Win pretty or stay on this list forever.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 3-0 with a league-best 499.94 points and this league STILL won't say her name.
posts.detail: triciagloston's middle-tier pedigree (6-7-1 career) is getting buried under 100 extra points compared to half this league's unbeaten teams — that's not a fluke, that's a statement nobody's making for her.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-3 with a league-worst 233.78 points, and Auntie Thomas's bottom-feeder résumé just keeps cashing checks.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record and a 10-average-finish pedigree promised mediocrity, but this is a full collapse — the hard way, chosen every single week.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 20-8, 1.5-average-finish résumé is now officially the biggest fraud in Busters Anonymous at 0-3.
posts.detail: Sixteen straight editions of burying Put it in Ra and the hole just keeps digging — 348.4 points for and nothing to show, a contender in name only.

posts.headline: tristanthepiston sits at 2-1 with 419.2 points — quietly outscoring both unbeaten division rivals, and nobody's talking about it.
posts.detail: A 7-7 career mark and dead-middle 7th-place pedigree means this is the definition of prove-it, but the Mexican Bald Fraud tag won't stick if the scoreboard keeps climbing.
